title: skenv tool config
description: skenv's own configuration, one per machine: ~/.config/skenv/config.toml (or config.yaml, config.yml, config.json; only one of them). Unknown keys are errors. Docs: https://qunaxis.github.io/skenv/configuration

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for editors. skenv ignores it.

manifest.description: The skenv file with the [user] section, or the directory that holds it ("~" allowed). `skenv init`, `skenv clone` and `skenv use` record it. There is no default: without it, commands that need the manifest stop with an error. Overridden by the flag --manifest and the environment variable SKENV_MANIFEST; precedence: flag, environment variable, this file, default.

machine.description: The name of this machine for user.machines.<name> of the manifest, which must then have that entry. Default: the full hostname if the manifest has rules for it, else the short hostname. Overridden by the environment variable SKENV_MACHINE; precedence: environment variable, this file, default.
